<svg viewBox="0 0 1200 700" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
    <style>
        .wall-outer { fill: #fcfcfd; stroke: #1e293b; stroke-width: 4; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-linecap: round; }
        .wall-major { fill: none; stroke: #334155; stroke-width: 2.8; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-linecap: square; }
        .wall-inner { fill: none; stroke: #64748b; stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-linecap: square; }
        .door-leaf { fill: none; stroke: #334155; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; }
        .door-swing { fill: none; stroke: #94a3b8; stroke-width: 1.1; stroke-dasharray: 2.5,2.5; }
        .fixture { fill: #f1f5f9; stroke: #cbd5e1; stroke-width: 1; }
        .fixture-dash { fill: none; stroke: #94a3b8; stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 3,3; }
        .crane-rail { fill: none; stroke: #f59e0b; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-dasharray: 6,4; }
        .safety-fence { fill: none; stroke: #ef4444; stroke-width: 1.4; stroke-dasharray: 4,3; }
        .safety-walkway { fill: none; stroke: #e2e8f0; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-dasharray: 4,4; }
        .room-label { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; fill: #475569; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-transform: uppercase; user-select: none; }
        .room-sub { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 8px; fill: #94a3b8; letter-spacing: 0.3px; user-select: none; }
    </style>

    <!-- Outer Perimeter (1100 x 600) -->
    <rect x="50" y="50" width="1100" height="600" class="wall-outer" />

    <!-- ==================== WEST BLOCK: TECH LABS & IT ==================== -->
    <!-- Major Dividing Firewall at x=300 -->
    <line x1="300" y1="50" x2="300" y2="230" class="wall-major" />
    <!-- Industrial Double Swing Doors into Factory Floor (y: 230..290) -->
    <line x1="300" y1="230" x2="300" y2="255" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 300,230 A 25,25 0 0,0 275,255" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="300" y1="290" x2="300" y2="265" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 300,290 A 25,25 0 0,1 275,265" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="300" y1="290" x2="300" y2="650" class="wall-major" />

    <!-- MDF Server Room: x: 50..230, y: 50..220 (rack at 170, 160) -->
    <line x1="230" y1="50" x2="230" y2="220" class="wall-major" />
    <line x1="50" y1="220" x2="180" y2="220" class="wall-major" />
    <!-- Door to server room (180..210) -->
    <line x1="180" y1="220" x2="180" y2="190" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 210,220 A 30,30 0 0,0 180,190" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="210" y1="220" x2="230" y2="220" class="wall-major" />
    <text x="65" y="75" class="room-label">MDF Server Room</text>
    <text x="65" y="88" class="room-sub">SCADA / OT Core / Fire Suppression</text>

    <!-- Telecom & Fiber Entrance: x: 230..300, y: 50..160 -->
    <line x1="230" y1="160" x2="300" y2="160" class="wall-inner" />
    <text x="238" y="75" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8.5px;">Fiber / ISP</text>

    <!-- Central Hallway Corridor: x: 230..300, y: 160..360 -->

    <!-- Shift Supervisor Office: x: 50..230, y: 220..310 -->
    <line x1="50" y1="310" x2="230" y2="310" class="wall-inner" />
    <!-- Door at (230, 240..270) -->
    <line x1="230" y1="240" x2="205" y2="240" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 230,270 A 30,30 0 0,1 205,240" class="door-swing" />
    <text x="65" y="245" class="room-label">Shift Supervisor</text>
    <text x="65" y="258" class="room-sub">Production Scheduling</text>

    <!-- Testing & Metrology Cleanroom Lab: x: 50..230, y: 310..540 (rack at 170, 460) -->
    <line x1="50" y1="540" x2="300" y2="540" class="wall-inner" />
    <line x1="230" y1="310" x2="230" y2="540" class="wall-major" />
    <text x="65" y="335" class="room-label">Quality Lab & Metrology</text>
    <text x="65" y="348" class="room-sub">3D CMM / Cleanroom Testing</text>
    <!-- Metrology inspection granite table fixture -->
    <rect x="70" y="380" width="55" height="40" class="fixture" />

    <!-- Airlock & Gowning Room: x: 230..300, y: 360..460 -->
    <line x1="230" y1="360" x2="300" y2="360" class="wall-inner" />
    <line x1="230" y1="460" x2="300" y2="460" class="wall-inner" />
    <!-- Outer door into corridor (230, 375..405) -->
    <line x1="230" y1="405" x2="210" y2="405" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 230,375 A 30,30 0 0,0 210,405" class="door-swing" />
    <!-- Inner cleanroom door (230, 485..515) -->
    <line x1="230" y1="485" x2="210" y2="485" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 230,515 A 30,30 0 0,1 210,485" class="door-swing" />
    <text x="238" y="380" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8.5px;">Airlock</text>
    <text x="238" y="392" class="room-sub" style="font-size: 7.5px;">Gowning</text>

    <!-- Staff Amenities (Lockers & Restrooms): x: 50..300, y: 540..650 -->
    <!-- Lockers (50..170) -->
    <line x1="170" y1="540" x2="170" y2="650" class="wall-inner" />
    <text x="65" y="565" class="room-label">Technician Lockers</text>
    <!-- Restrooms (170..300) -->
    <line x1="240" y1="540" x2="240" y2="650" class="wall-inner" />
    <text x="180" y="565" class="room-label">WC 1</text>
    <text x="250" y="565" class="room-label">WC 2</text>

    <!-- ==================== CENTER BLOCK: PRODUCTION ==================== -->
    <!-- CNC Machining Workshop: x: 300..880, y: 50..350 (rack at 575, 200) -->
    <text x="325" y="75" class="room-label" style="font-size: 12px;">CNC Machining Workshop</text>
    <text x="325" y="90" class="room-sub">Milling Centers / Wire EDM / Precision Lathes</text>

    <!-- Overhead Crane Runway Rails -->
    <line x1="330" y1="105" x2="850" y2="105" class="crane-rail" />
    <line x1="330" y1="315" x2="850" y2="315" class="crane-rail" />

    <!-- Machine Footprints -->
    <!-- AgieCharmilles Wire EDM -->
    <rect x="340" y="130" width="75" height="50" class="fixture" />
    <text x="348" y="158" class="room-sub" style="font-size: 7.5px; fill: #64748b;">Wire EDM</text>

    <!-- Bystronic Press Brake -->
    <rect x="450" y="130" width="85" height="50" class="fixture" />
    <text x="458" y="158" class="room-sub" style="font-size: 7.5px; fill: #64748b;">Press Brake</text>

    <!-- 5-Axis Milling Center 1 -->
    <rect x="670" y="130" width="75" height="50" class="fixture" />
    <text x="678" y="158" class="room-sub" style="font-size: 7.5px; fill: #64748b;">5-Axis CNC 1</text>

    <!-- 5-Axis Milling Center 2 -->
    <rect x="770" y="130" width="75" height="50" class="fixture" />
    <text x="778" y="158" class="room-sub" style="font-size: 7.5px; fill: #64748b;">5-Axis CNC 2</text>

    <!-- Chip & Coolant Filtration Zone -->
    <rect x="340" y="240" width="60" height="35" class="fixture-dash" />
    <text x="348" y="260" class="room-sub" style="font-size: 7.5px;">Coolant Tank</text>

    <!-- Central Safety Pedestrian Walkway / Forklift Aisle (y: 335..375) -->
    <line x1="300" y1="335" x2="880" y2="335" class="safety-walkway" />
    <line x1="300" y1="375" x2="880" y2="375" class="safety-walkway" />
    <text x="325" y="358" class="room-sub" style="font-size: 8px; fill: #94a3b8; font-weight: 600;">◄ SAFETY TRANSIT WALKWAY ►</text>

    <!-- Robotics Bay & Automated Cells: x: 300..880, y: 375..650 (rack at 575, 500) -->
    <text x="325" y="405" class="room-label" style="font-size: 12px;">Robotics & Automated Assembly</text>
    <text x="325" y="420" class="room-sub">Industrial Robot Cells / Sick Safety Light Curtains</text>

    <!-- Robot Cell 1 with Perimeter Fencing -->
    <rect x="340" y="440" width="160" height="120" class="safety-fence" />
    <circle cx="420" cy="500" r="22" class="fixture" />
    <text x="385" y="495" class="room-sub" style="font-size: 8px; fill: #ef4444; font-weight: 600;">ROBOT CELL 1</text>
    <text x="388" y="510" class="room-sub" style="font-size: 7.5px;">Pilz Safety Gate</text>

    <!-- Robot Cell 2 with Perimeter Fencing -->
    <rect x="670" y="440" width="160" height="120" class="safety-fence" />
    <circle cx="750" cy="500" r="22" class="fixture" />
    <text x="715" y="495" class="room-sub" style="font-size: 8px; fill: #ef4444; font-weight: 600;">ROBOT CELL 2</text>
    <text x="718" y="510" class="room-sub" style="font-size: 7.5px;">Pilz Safety Gate</text>

    <!-- Raw Material / Infeed Pallet Staging -->
    <rect x="340" y="580" width="110" height="30" class="fixture-dash" />
    <rect x="720" y="580" width="110" height="30" class="fixture-dash" />

    <!-- ==================== EAST BLOCK: MAINTENANCE & UTILITIES ==================== -->
    <!-- Major Fire-separating Wall between Production and Maintenance at x=880 -->
    <line x1="880" y1="50" x2="880" y2="200" class="wall-major" />
    <!-- Sliding Industrial Door (y: 200..260) -->
    <line x1="880" y1="200" x2="880" y2="260" class="fixture-dash" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="880" y1="260" x2="880" y2="440" class="wall-major" />
    <!-- Sliding Industrial Door (y: 440..500) -->
    <line x1="880" y1="440" x2="880" y2="500" class="fixture-dash" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="880" y1="500" x2="880" y2="650" class="wall-major" />

    <!-- Screw Compressors & Pneumatics: x: 880..1150, y: 50..180 -->
    <line x1="880" y1="180" x2="1150" y2="180" class="wall-major" />
    <!-- Compressor units -->
    <rect x="910" y="80" width="60" height="40" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="990" y="80" width="60" height="40" class="fixture" />
    <text x="910" y="145" class="room-label">Compressor Room</text>
    <text x="910" y="158" class="room-sub">Atlas Copco Screw Compressors</text>

    <!-- Maintenance Workshop & Tool Crib: x: 880..1150, y: 180..490 (rack at 1005, 350) -->
    <text x="910" y="215" class="room-label">Maintenance Workshop</text>
    <text x="910" y="228" class="room-sub">Tool Dispenser & Mechanical Repairs</text>
    <!-- Tool Crib Cage -->
    <rect x="910" y="250" width="70" height="50" class="fixture-dash" />
    <text x="920" y="278" class="room-sub" style="font-size: 7.5px;">Matrix Crib</text>
    <!-- Maintenance Workbenches -->
    <rect x="1070" y="250" width="60" height="25" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="1070" y="290" width="60" height="25" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="1070" y="390" width="60" height="25" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="1070" y="430" width="60" height="25" class="fixture" />

    <!-- Main Electrical Switchgear & Generator: x: 880..1150, y: 490..650 -->
    <line x1="880" y1="490" x2="1150" y2="490" class="wall-major" />
    <!-- Switchgear Panels -->
    <rect x="910" y="520" width="110" height="30" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="910" y="565" width="110" height="30" class="fixture" />
    <text x="910" y="618" class="room-label">Main Switchgear</text>
    <text x="910" y="630" class="room-sub">CAT Diesel Genset / Power Quality</text>
</svg>
